title: Writable config consumed by a privileged service with a reload mechanism
impact: A writable configuration file consumed by a root service that reloads it can become code execution as root; the combination may not be covered by a single-finding detector.
remediation: Restrict write on the config; confirm the service's reload behavior; run the service least-privileged.
description: A writable config path co-occurs with a privileged service/reload mechanism - review as an unrecognized local-root path.

title: Container boundary weakness with host primitive
impact: A container context with a host-reaching primitive is a likely escape to the node.
remediation: Drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN; do not expose the docker socket; avoid hostPath/privileged pods.
description: Containerization co-occurs with a host-reaching primitive; review for node escape.
